verdict.rationale: Rive's docs confirm automatic revision tracking, non-destructive restore, and the ability to select and edit a prior revision (rive-docs-12, rive-docs-17, rive-docs-29), which covers 'restore any earlier state.' However there is no evidence of naming/labeling milestones or a compare/diff view between versions. Missing for 10: named milestone/labeling capability, side-by-side or diff comparison between revisions, independent corroboration of the restore workflow.
